description:
Render live-updating model output for in-flight steps.

=== Scope ===

Per ARCH §12 v0.5 success criterion: "live streaming". Per §3.5 the only read mechanism is filesystem watching.

- A step is in-flight when its directory under steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/ exists but the step's terminal artifact (response/output file written at completion) is absent. Pin the exact filename in the implementation against the v0.3 step layout (§2.3, §2.2) — do not coin a new path.
- The fs_watcher already coalesces writes under steps/. Extend the view-model so the in-flight step's text content is read on each tick and rendered live in the appropriate node of the git tree.
- Stateless: re-reading the file from disk on every tick is the contract (§3.5). No in-memory accumulation buffer that could drift.
- View-model unit tested against fixture repos with partial step files. No mocking of fs.
- Renderer test: given an in-flight step view-model with text X, the rendered widget contains text X.

=== Non-goals ===

- Token-by-token animation effects.
- Backpressure / virtualization for very long outputs (file in a follow-up if needed).

=== Gates ===

Tests, docs, alignment per AGENTS.md.
title: UI: live streaming text for in-flight model calls
